name: day-trader-skill-india
description: The Day Trader skill pack for Claude, for the Indian market (NSE / BSE)

plugins.name: day-trader-skill-india
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for NSE intraday trading: a chart scanner, an Indian news monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner with NSE ticks and MIS square-off, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager that counts STT and charges, an order ticket for any Indian broker (practice by default, never without your yes), price alerts, an earnings analyst and a promoter / bulk-deal tracker.
